phases.name: Base
phases.focus: Aerobic endurance and consistent easy running

phases.name: Taper
phases.notes: Volume drops to 70‑80% then 40‑50% of peak; keep short race‑pace strides; no heavy legs.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.notes: No speedwork; easy jogs and cross‑training; return to base after 3 weeks.

args.summary: 19-week periodized plan for sub-50 10K on Nov 8. Base builds aerobic volume to ~45 km/wk, Build adds threshold/intervals, Peak sharpens with race-pace work, short 12-day taper preserves freshness.

phases.name: Base
phases.focus: Aerobic base, consistent volume, easy runs + strides
phases.notes: 3-4 easy runs + 1 long run (16-18 km), 2 strength sessions/wk

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Threshold and VO2max intervals, long run holds 18-20 km
phases.notes: Add 1 quality session/wk (tempo or intervals), keep 2 strength

phases.name: Peak
phases.notes: Key workouts: 5×2 km @ 5:00/km, 3×3 km @ 5:00/km, long run 18 km

phases.name: Taper
phases.focus: Reduce volume 40-50%, keep short race-pace intervals
phases.notes: Cut long run to 10-12 km, 4-6 strides, drop heavy legs in gym

phases.name: Recovery
phases.notes: Week 1: 2-3 rest days, short easy jogs. Week 2: back to normal if legs fresh
